verdict.rationale: Steel is a browser API for AI agents, so an observe/plan primitive that previews candidate actions before executing them is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack shows no such capability. Page snapshots and markdown/screenshot tools are raw building blocks, agent traces are after-the-fact observability, and human-in-the-loop debug URLs are live manual control; none of these previews candidate actions before the agent commits.

support.subject: As a developer, I can preview candidate actions on the current page (observe/plan) before committing the agent to act
